answer: An attester must stake 9% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the relic stake is held until the nebula settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the summit audit lists each exposure. A farm running 150 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap.
